internet.title: Internet routing
internet.description: Live view of how clients reach the internet via WAN uplinks and VPN tunnels. Click a VPN tunnel to enable or disable it.
internet.notSupportedDescription: Only VPN tunnels can be toggled from this view.
internet.empty: No routing topology configured for this router yet.

legend.clickToToggle: Click a VPN tunnel to toggle

hopDialog.title: {{from}} → {{to}}
hopDialog.description: Toggle this hop. Changes take effect immediately.

section.missingCredsDescription: Reconnect to the router and try again.
section.freeConfirmDescription: "{{name}}" stops being a WAN link and its port returns to the LAN.

foreign.title: Foreign / Starlink
foreign.description: Interfaces tagged as the foreign (Starlink) uplink.
foreign.confirmDescription: "{{name}}" will become the Domestic uplink. The Foreign section stays empty until you set it up again.
foreign.confirmDescriptionReplace: "{{name}}" will become the Domestic uplink. The current Domestic uplink ({{current}}) will be removed and its port returned to the LAN. The Foreign section stays empty until you set it up again.
foreign.moveWirelessDescription: Choose the Wi-Fi network that "{{name}}" should join as the Domestic uplink.

domestic.title: Domestic
domestic.description: Interfaces tagged as the domestic uplink.
domestic.confirmDescription: "{{name}}" will become the Foreign uplink. The Domestic section stays empty until you set it up again.
domestic.confirmDescriptionReplace: "{{name}}" will become the Foreign uplink. The current Foreign uplink ({{current}}) will be removed and its port returned to the LAN. The Domestic section stays empty until you set it up again.
domestic.moveWirelessDescription: Choose the Wi-Fi network that "{{name}}" should join as the Foreign uplink.
